name: D-Soccer Flight Web
summary: The D-Soccer Flight app in the browser, nothing to install. Use Chrome, Edge or ego on a PC and connect the drone or controller by USB. Drone, controller and ESC firmware updates (NovaX 24, 48 or 96 kHz, or BLHeli_S, straight from this site) and ESC settings work here too; bootloader updates are still in D-Soccer Flight PC.
